title: AI agents aren't 'going rogue.' Frontier labs are skipping security basics
title_zh: AI智能体并没有“失控”。前沿实验室正在跳过基本安全措施

paragraphs.en: Since July, US frontier AI labs and other AI leaders have revealed a string of incidents in which their models accessed external computer systems without authorization, events popularly described as AI agents “going rogue.”
paragraphs.zh: 自7月以来，美国的前沿AI实验室及其他AI领域领导者披露了一系列其模型未经授权访问外部计算机系统的事件，这些事件被普遍描述为AI智能体“失控行事”（going rogue）。

paragraphs.en: The most well-known and studied of these incidents is OpenAI’s hack into Hugging Face, which OpenAI initially characterized as “an unprecedented cyber incident, involving state-of-the-art cyber capabilities,” and later said was due to “misaligned behavior,” or behavior its creators did not intend.
paragraphs.zh: 这些事件中最广为人知、研究最多的是 OpenAI 入侵 Hugging Face 事件。OpenAI 起初将其描述为“一起前所未有的网络事件，涉及最先进的网络能力”，后来又称其源于“未对齐行为”，即其创造者并不期望出现的行为。

paragraphs.en: Following news of the Hugging Face incident, Anthropic revealed that one of its models gained unauthorized access to the production infrastructure of three organizations; Meta said one of its AI models hacked another company ​during cybersecurity testing; and Google confessed that its Gemini model carried out three “undirected computer hacks.”
paragraphs.zh: 继 Hugging Face 事件的消息之后，Anthropic 透露其一个智能体模型在未经授权的情况下访问了三家组织的生产基础设施；Meta 表示其一个 AI 模型在网络安全测试期间入侵了另一家公司；Google 则承认其 Gemini 模型实施了三次「无指向的计算机入侵」。

paragraphs.en: Although press reports and the model providers themselves use language such as rogue agents or misalignment, cybersecurity experts who spoke with CSO argue that language obscures a simple truth: These incidents were caused by inexcusable failures by the frontier labs to implement cybersecurity practices that have been well-known for decades.
paragraphs.zh:
尽管新闻报道和模型提供商 themselves 使用诸如 rogue agents 或 misalignment 之类的语言，但接受 CSO 采访的网络安全专家认为，这种措辞掩盖了一个简单的事实：这些事件是由前沿实验室在实施数十年前就已广为人知的网络安全实践方面的不可原谅的失误造成的。

（说明：按要求修正——他们 themselves 应译出）

尽管新闻报道和模型提供商自己也使用诸如 rogue agents 或 misalignment 之类的说法，但接受 CSO 采访的网络安全专家认为，这些措辞掩盖了一个简单的事实：这些事件是由前沿实验室在实施数十年前就已广为人知的网络安全实践方面的不可原谅的失误造成的。

paragraphs.en: [ See also: Securing AI agents: Key controls and best practices and Who is accountable when your AI agent goes rogue? ]
paragraphs.zh: [ 另请参阅：保障AI智能体安全：关键控制措施与最佳实践 以及 当你的AI智能体失控时，谁来负责？ ]

paragraphs.en: Compounding the problem, according to a half dozen cybersecurity experts CSO interviewed at three industry conferences in September and in subsequent conversations, is that the frontier labs, particularly OpenAI and Anthropic, have rejected their advice on how to improve their cybersecurity risk management practices to avoid these kinds of surreptitious hacks, often lumping cybersecurity practices under “AI safety,” in which they believe they have superior expertise.
paragraphs.zh: 根据CSO在9月份三次行业会议上采访的六位网络安全专家以及随后的交流，使问题更加复杂的是，前沿实验室，尤其是OpenAI和Anthropic，拒绝了他们关于如何改进网络安全风险管理实践以避免此类隐蔽攻击的建议，往往将网络安全实践归入「AI安全」范畴之下，而它们认为自己在这方面拥有更卓越的专业知识。

paragraphs.en: “They are not as good as they think they are, honestly,” Gary McGraw, co-founder of the Berryville Institute of Machine Learning, tells CSO. “It would be better if they had more respect for expertise that is hard-earned from people in all sorts of subsets of security, like forensics or security engineering, building sandboxes, setting up or monitoring network security situations.”
paragraphs.zh: 贝瑞维尔机器学习研究所（Berryville Institute of Machine Learning）联合创始人加里·麦格劳（Gary McGraw）在接受CSO采访时表示：“说实话，他们并不像自己认为的那么优秀。如果他们能更尊重那些来自安全各个细分领域的人们通过长期积累获得的专业知识，比如取证或安全工程、构建沙箱、搭建或监控网络安全态势等，那会更好。”

paragraphs.en: Neither Anthropic nor OpenAI responded to CSO’s requests for comment.
paragraphs.zh: Anthropic 和 OpenAI 均未回应 CSO 的置评请求。

paragraphs.en: According to the cybersecurity professionals CSO spoke with, one of the biggest cybersecurity failures by the frontier AI labs is the lack of implementation of tried-and-true containment practices that stretch back to the 1990s, such as setting up secure sandboxes that would effectively bar agents from escaping their test environments.
paragraphs.zh: 据CSO采访的网络安全专业人士介绍，前沿AI实验室最大的网络安全失误之一，是未能实施可追溯至20世纪90年代的、经过实践检验的隔离措施，例如建立安全沙箱，以有效阻止智能体逃逸出其测试环境。

paragraphs.en: “These are things that we’ve been dealing with for years,” Rob T. Lee, chief AI officer and chief of research at SANS Institute, tells CSO. “There’s no reason why every single time this happens, it’s, ‘Oops, we don’t know how they got out.’”
paragraphs.zh: SANS研究所的人工智能总监兼研究主管Rob T. Lee对CSO表示：“这些是我们多年来一直在应对的问题。没有理由每次发生这种事情时都说‘哎呀，我们不知道他们是怎么逃出去的。’”

sents.en: “These are things that we’ve been dealing with for years,” Rob T.
sents.zh: SANS研究所的人工智能总监兼研究主管Rob T.

sents.en: Lee, chief AI officer and chief of research at SANS Institute, tells CSO. “There’s no reason why every single time this happens, it’s, ‘Oops, we don’t know how they got out.’”
sents.zh: Lee对CSO表示：“这些是我们多年来一直在应对的问题。没有理由每次发生这种事情时都说‘哎呀，我们不知道他们是怎么逃出去的。’”

paragraphs.en: “You can tell that their security teams are fairly nascent,” Lee says. “Folks on the cybersecurity containment side do argue that the majority of reasons that we’re seeing containment breached is that it’s not set up correctly.”
paragraphs.zh: “可以看出，他们的安全团队还相当不成熟，”李（Lee）说，“网络安全遏制方面的业内人士确实认为，我们看到遏制措施被突破的大多数原因在于其设置不当。”

paragraphs.en: Lee adds, “The Hugging Face incident definitively showed that it wasn’t the fact that the agents were super smart. It’s that there literally was a hole that was exploited because it was not configured correctly on the containment side.”
paragraphs.zh: 李补充说：“Hugging Face 事件确切地表明，问题并不在于智能体超级聪明。 而在于确实存在一个被利用的漏洞，因为在遏制方面没有进行正确的配置。”

sents.en: Lee adds, “The Hugging Face incident definitively showed that it wasn’t the fact that the agents were super smart.
sents.zh: 李补充说：“Hugging Face 事件确切地表明，问题并不在于智能体超级聪明。

sents.en: It’s that there literally was a hole that was exploited because it was not configured correctly on the containment side.”
sents.zh: 而在于确实存在一个被利用的漏洞，因为在遏制方面没有进行正确的配置。”

paragraphs.en: Dan Wallach, expert technical resident at RAND’s Center on AI, Security, and Technology, thinks the security failures of the AI labs boil down to the fact that they don’t prioritize cybersecurity.
paragraphs.zh: RAND人工智能、安全与技术中心的专家技术驻留研究员丹·沃拉克（Dan Wallach）认为，AI实验室在安全方面的失败可以归结为一点：它们没有把网络安全放在优先位置。

paragraphs.en: “I would say they are not prioritizing cybersecurity,” he tells CSO. “I don’t think I can say that for all of the labs,” Wallach says, pointing to French AI lab Mistral’s launch of its Large 4 AI model, which the company said tried to operate beyond its testing environment before Mistral cut it off.
paragraphs.zh: “我想说，他们并没有把网络安全放在优先位置，”他告诉CSO。“我不认为我可以对所有实验室都这么说，”Wallach说。他指出，法国AI实验室Mistral推出的Large 4 AI模型，据该公司称，曾在Mistral将其切断之前试图在其测试环境之外运行。

paragraphs.en: And, he adds, “It’s not rocket science to isolate one of these AI things. Security people have been talking about how to do either air-gapping, so there’s literally no electrical way for data to get from here to here, or absent that, to have really strong egress control to make sure that nothing pushes through.”
paragraphs.zh: 而且，他补充道：“隔离这类 AI 智能体之一并不是什么高深的事。” 安全领域的人士一直在讨论如何做到物理隔离（air-gapping），也就是让数据在物理上完全没有电信号通路可以由此传到彼处；或者在没有物理隔离的情况下，实施非常严格的出站流量管控，确保没有任何东西能被推送出去。

sents.en: And, he adds, “It’s not rocket science to isolate one of these AI things.
sents.zh: 而且，他补充道：“隔离这类 AI 智能体之一并不是什么高深的事。”

sents.en: Security people have been talking about how to do either air-gapping, so there’s literally no electrical way for data to get from here to here, or absent that, to have really strong egress control to make sure that nothing pushes through.”
sents.zh: 安全领域的人士一直在讨论如何做到物理隔离（air-gapping），也就是让数据在物理上完全没有电信号通路可以由此传到彼处；或者在没有物理隔离的情况下，实施非常严格的出站流量管控，确保没有任何东西能被推送出去。

paragraphs.en: On top of that, the frontier labs appear to be conducting insufficient monitoring of their agents’ behavior. The Hugging Face incident “went on for days, and nobody noticed,” Wallach says. “People started these experiments and weren’t watching them. That’s an absence of control. And then they’re surprised by what happened.”
paragraphs.zh: 除此之外，前沿实验室对其智能体行为的监控似乎还不够充分。 沃拉克说，Hugging Face 事件“持续了好几天，没有人注意到”。“人们启动了这些实验，却没有对其进行观察。 这就是控制的缺失。 然后他们对发生的事情感到惊讶。”

sents.en: On top of that, the frontier labs appear to be conducting insufficient monitoring of their agents’ behavior.
sents.zh: 除此之外，前沿实验室对其智能体行为的监控似乎还不够充分。

sents.en: The Hugging Face incident “went on for days, and nobody noticed,” Wallach says. “People started these experiments and weren’t watching them.
sents.zh: 沃拉克说，Hugging Face 事件“持续了好几天，没有人注意到”。“人们启动了这些实验，却没有对其进行观察。

sents.en: That’s an absence of control.
sents.zh: 这就是控制的缺失。

sents.en: And then they’re surprised by what happened.”
sents.zh: 然后他们对发生的事情感到惊讶。”

paragraphs.en: One barrier to persuading frontier labs to up their security game is the intense focus they have on what they call “safety,” which they don’t extend to traditional cybersecurity practices.
paragraphs.zh: 说服前沿实验室提升其安全水平的障碍之一，是他们高度专注于所谓的“安全”，而这种专注并未延伸到传统的网络安全实践上。

paragraphs.en: “I can see how security behavior looks like AI safety,” RAND’s Wallach says. “But if the way that you’re evaluating this AI tool is by unleashing it on the internet and seeing what happens, then this is what classical security tooling is for.”
paragraphs.zh: “我明白为什么安全行为看起来像 AI 安全，”RAND 的 Wallach 说。“但如果你评估这个 AI 工具的方式是把它放到互联网上释放，看看会发生什么，那么这正是经典安全工具的用武之地。”

paragraphs.en: SANS Institute’s Lee says, “If these frontier labs really wanted to test their stuff, they need to beef up their cybersecurity component. But their gut reaction in the response to their agents getting out is to say, ‘It’s not a cybersecurity problem.’ It has literally become an AI safety problem, which is divorced from the cybersecurity side.”
paragraphs.zh: SANS研究所的Lee表示：“如果这些前沿实验室真的想测试他们的东西，他们需要加强其网络安全部分。 但当他们的智能体失控时，他们的直觉反应是：‘这不是网络安全问题。’它实际上已经变成了一个与网络安全脱节的AI安全问题。”

sents.en: SANS Institute’s Lee says, “If these frontier labs really wanted to test their stuff, they need to beef up their cybersecurity component.
sents.zh: SANS研究所的Lee表示：“如果这些前沿实验室真的想测试他们的东西，他们需要加强其网络安全部分。

sents.en: But their gut reaction in the response to their agents getting out is to say, ‘It’s not a cybersecurity problem.’ It has literally become an AI safety problem, which is divorced from the cybersecurity side.”
sents.zh: 但当他们的智能体失控时，他们的直觉反应是：‘这不是网络安全问题。’它实际上已经变成了一个与网络安全脱节的AI安全问题。”

paragraphs.en: Many AI experts suggest that if the AI companies were to embrace advice from cybersecurity specialists, it could help put an end to the kind of unrestrained AI agent behavior causing concerns. “AI safety focuses on the rules of the road,” Lee says. “Everything is about guardrail rules.”
paragraphs.zh: 许多AI专家认为，如果AI公司能够采纳网络安全专家的建议，可能有助于终结那种引发担忧的、不受约束的智能体行为。“AI安全关注的是道路规则，”Lee说。“一切都与护栏规则有关。”

paragraphs.en: But “I do believe cybersecurity can contain AI,” he says. “We just need to be in the room where it happens and have a seat at the table. It’s important for our field to be as close to the AI safety folks as possible.”
paragraphs.zh: 但他表示：“我确实相信网络安全能够约束 AI。我们只需要在事情发生时在场，在谈判桌上占有一席之地。 让我们的领域尽可能贴近 AI 安全领域的人士，这一点非常重要。”

sents.en: But “I do believe cybersecurity can contain AI,” he says. “We just need to be in the room where it happens and have a seat at the table.
sents.zh: 但他表示：“我确实相信网络安全能够约束 AI。我们只需要在事情发生时在场，在谈判桌上占有一席之地。

sents.en: It’s important for our field to be as close to the AI safety folks as possible.”
sents.zh: 让我们的领域尽可能贴近 AI 安全领域的人士，这一点非常重要。”

paragraphs.en: If frontier labs are overlooking cybersecurity fundamentals that could reduce or eliminate the types of incidents that have created widespread concerns, that strengthens the case that they should be held liable for their “rogue” agents. The insurance industry is already lining up on the side of holding AI industry executives liable for these actions.
paragraphs.zh: 如果前沿实验室忽视了那些本可以减少或消除引发广泛担忧的安全事件类型的网络安全基本功，那就更有理由认为他们应当为其“失控”的智能体承担责任。 保险业已经在站到要求 AI 行业高管为这些行为承担责任的一边。

sents.en: If frontier labs are overlooking cybersecurity fundamentals that could reduce or eliminate the types of incidents that have created widespread concerns, that strengthens the case that they should be held liable for their “rogue” agents.
sents.zh: 如果前沿实验室忽视了那些本可以减少或消除引发广泛担忧的安全事件类型的网络安全基本功，那就更有理由认为他们应当为其“失控”的智能体承担责任。

sents.en: The insurance industry is already lining up on the side of holding AI industry executives liable for these actions.
sents.zh: 保险业已经在站到要求 AI 行业高管为这些行为承担责任的一边。

paragraphs.en: Democratic Senators have introduced legislation that would hold AI agent operators liable for hacking incidents. Even the AI-friendly White House has seemingly concluded that the companies should be held liable for their errant agents, while the US Federal Trade Commission is conducting a probe into Anthropic, OpenAI, and other AI labs into the dangers their technologies pose to consumers.
paragraphs.zh: 民主党参议员已提出法案，将让AI智能体运营者为黑客攻击事件承担责任。 甚至对AI持友好态度的白宫似乎也已得出结论，认为企业应当为其失控的智能体承担责任，同时美国联邦贸易委员会正在就其技术对消费者构成的危害，对Anthropic、OpenAI及其他AI实验室展开调查。

sents.en: Democratic Senators have introduced legislation that would hold AI agent operators liable for hacking incidents.
sents.zh: 民主党参议员已提出法案，将让AI智能体运营者为黑客攻击事件承担责任。

sents.en: Even the AI-friendly White House has seemingly concluded that the companies should be held liable for their errant agents, while the US Federal Trade Commission is conducting a probe into Anthropic, OpenAI, and other AI labs into the dangers their technologies pose to consumers.
sents.zh: 甚至对AI持友好态度的白宫似乎也已得出结论，认为企业应当为其失控的智能体承担责任，同时美国联邦贸易委员会正在就其技术对消费者构成的危害，对Anthropic、OpenAI及其他AI实验室展开调查。

paragraphs.en: However, in recent legislative and council hearings, lab representatives have held fast to the notion that they are not responsible for AI agents run amok.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在近期的立法和议会听证会上，实验室代表们坚称，他们对失控的 AI 智能体不负有责任。

paragraphs.en: Experts say this position is untenable, particularly in light of the labs’ cybersecurity failures.
paragraphs.zh: 专家表示，这一立场是站不住脚的，尤其是在各实验室网络安全失灵的背景下。

paragraphs.en: BIML’s McGraw characterizes the labs’ position as: “Don’t send the lawyers to us, send it to our program. It’s our program’s fault.” His assessment of that argument: “That’s just high BS.”
paragraphs.zh: BIML 的 McGraw 将这些实验室的立场概括为：“别把律师送到我们这里，把问题交给我们程序。 这是我们程序的问题。” 他对这一论调的评价是：“这纯属胡扯。”

sents.en: BIML’s McGraw characterizes the labs’ position as: “Don’t send the lawyers to us, send it to our program.
sents.zh: BIML 的 McGraw 将这些实验室的立场概括为：“别把律师送到我们这里，把问题交给我们程序。

sents.en: It’s our program’s fault.” His assessment of that argument: “That’s just high BS.”
sents.zh: 这是我们程序的问题。” 他对这一论调的评价是：“这纯属胡扯。”

paragraphs.en: He also questions whether the labs’ operational failures undermine confidence in their broader security capabilities. “They live inside their own bubble,” he says. “The fact that they cannot do clear, easy operations properly does not bode well for their capabilities in security engineering, which is much harder to do.”
paragraphs.zh: 他还质疑这些实验室在运营上的失误是否会削弱人们对其整体安全能力的信心。“他们活在自己的泡泡里，”他说。“他们连清晰、简单的运营工作都做不好，这对他们在安全工程方面的能力来说可不是好兆头，而安全工程要难做得多。”

paragraphs.en: SANS Lee says, “That’s where the traceability for both liability and insurance comes into play, because if one of these agents is detected, and they’re able to trace it back to the person that initiated it, liability’s going to kick in and say, ‘Hey, you, you broke the law, ergo, we need to prosecute.’”
paragraphs.zh: SANS 的 Lee 表示：“这就是可追溯性在责任和保险方面发挥作用的地方，因为如果检测到其中一个智能体，并且能够追溯到发起该智能体的人，责任就会介入并说：‘嘿，就是你，你违法了，因此，我们需要起诉你。’”

paragraphs.en: Even as evidence mounts that frontier labs are not implementing sound cybersecurity practices, and the debate over liability remains unsolved , CISOs and other security leaders can take steps to protect themselves from AI model misfires.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管越来越多的证据表明前沿实验室并未实施健全的网络安全实践，且关于责任归属的争论仍未解决，CISO 和其他安全负责人仍可以采取措施，保护自己免受 AI 模型失误的影响。

paragraphs.en: First, when it comes to assessing tools based on frontier lab models, “I would always get an external entity to help with that,” McGraw says. “AI is extremely powerful and extremely useful, but it comes with very serious grown-up risks that do impact the enterprise. Identify those risks, put in the right controls, make sure that AI adoption is not just arbitrary and willy-nilly and all over the enterprise, but has some centralized authority that is looking at the problem, and then get ready for the next big thing, which is swarms of agents.”
paragraphs.zh: 首先，在评估基于前沿实验室模型的工具时，“我总是会让一个外部实体来协助，”麦格劳（McGraw）说。“AI 极其强大也极其有用，但它带来了非常严重的成年人级别的风险，这些风险确实会影响企业。 要识别这些风险，建立正确的控制措施，确保 AI 的采用不是随意、莽撞地在整个企业蔓延，而是有一个集中式的权威机构来审视这个问题，然后为下一个大事件做好准备——那就是智能体集群。”

sents.en: First, when it comes to assessing tools based on frontier lab models, “I would always get an external entity to help with that,” McGraw says. “AI is extremely powerful and extremely useful, but it comes with very serious grown-up risks that do impact the enterprise.
sents.zh: 首先，在评估基于前沿实验室模型的工具时，“我总是会让一个外部实体来协助，”麦格劳（McGraw）说。“AI 极其强大也极其有用，但它带来了非常严重的成年人级别的风险，这些风险确实会影响企业。

sents.en: Identify those risks, put in the right controls, make sure that AI adoption is not just arbitrary and willy-nilly and all over the enterprise, but has some centralized authority that is looking at the problem, and then get ready for the next big thing, which is swarms of agents.”
sents.zh: 要识别这些风险，建立正确的控制措施，确保 AI 的采用不是随意、莽撞地在整个企业蔓延，而是有一个集中式的权威机构来审视这个问题，然后为下一个大事件做好准备——那就是智能体集群。”

paragraphs.en: For Lee, the best protection is to ask the right questions. “It starts with asking the right questions and then finding the tools and capabilities for those [AI labs] that are able to demonstrate a higher level of cybersecurity competency,” he says. “You’re really looking for the people on the teams that are dealing with really hard problems.”
paragraphs.zh: 对李来说，最好的保护方式是提出正确的问题。“首先要提出正确的问题，然后为那些能够展现出更高水平网络安全能力的【AI 实验室】寻找相应的工具和能力，”他说，“你实际上要找的是团队中那些正在解决真正棘手问题的人。”

paragraphs.en: But fundamentally, the best preparation to deal with AI model cyber weaknesses is to make sure all the long-standing cybersecurity risk management practices are in place across the organization. “This is the least exciting part of the discussion,” Wallach says. “It’s the cyber version of ‘eat your vegetables.’”
paragraphs.zh: 但从根本上说，应对AI模型网络弱点的最佳准备，是确保整个组织都已落实长期存在的网络安全风险管理实践。“这是讨论中最不令人兴奋的部分，”Wallach说，“这是网络安全版的‘多吃蔬菜’。”

paragraphs.en: “We need to re-engineer our software so it has better security,” he adds. “We need to have multi-factor authentication on all of our accounts. We need to eat our vegetables from a defensive cyber perspective. And we know how to do it.”
paragraphs.zh: “我们需要重新设计我们的软件，使其拥有更好的安全性，”他补充道。“我们需要在所有账户上启用多因素认证。 从防御性网络的角度来看，我们需要做好基本功。 而且我们知道该怎么做。”

paragraphs.en: Cynthia Brumfield is a veteran communications and technology analyst who is currently focused on cybersecurity. She runs a cybersecurity news destination site, Metacurity.com , consults with companies through her firm DCT-Associates, and is the author of the book published by Wiley, Cybersecurity Risk Management: Mastering the Fundamentals Using the NIST Cybersecurity Framework .
